title: Aim. Walk. Sketch. Phone sensors in action | outlineGo
description:
Aim at the next corner, capture direction, start the step counter, stand still and stop, then save the next point. See how outlineGo turns a direction and an estimated length into a 2D sketch.

Emulator demonstration with simulated direction and step readings. The virtual camera uses an AI-generated garden image. The app interface, length calculation, saving and PNG export are real. This is not a recording of physical measurement or sensor accuracy. The camera is a viewfinder; step-based lengths are estimates.

Get outlineGo for Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.bk.dev.mobile.outlinego
App website: https://outlinego.com/en/

title: 8 steps to an estimated length — outlineGo step counter
description:
Start at the corner, walk the side, stand still and press Stop. With a 75 cm step length, 8 counted steps give an estimated 6 m side. Set the step length to suit your own stride.

Emulator demonstration with simulated direction and step readings. The virtual camera uses an AI-generated garden image. The app interface, length calculation, saving and PNG export are real. title: A 5 × 4 m room sketch on your phone | outlineGo
description:
Keep a room outline on your phone: enter a side, correct 4.8 m to 5 m, review the 18 m perimeter and 20 m² area, then export a PNG. Watermarked PNG export is included in Free.

The opening room scene is an AI-generated illustration. App screens and the original PNG are real; directions and lengths were entered manually. The closing side is calculated. Check dimensions separately before buying furniture or materials.

title: From phone sketch to DXF and CAD | outlineGo Plus
description:
Export a sketch as DXF with outlineGo Plus, open the same file in LibreCAD and check the drawing unit and geometry. This example is a 4 × 3 m rectangle with a 14 m perimeter. LibreCAD is separate software.

Actual app export and CAD screens with demonstration data. A temporary test Plus entitlement was used for the source recording; this is not a purchase demonstration. DXF export requires Plus. No private file browser or computer history is shown.
